events.title: Vasco da Gama dies in Cochin
events.description: The Portuguese navigator who opened the sea route from Europe to India around Africa died in Cochin, India. He had returned to India as Portugal's viceroy.
events.significance: His voyages linked Europe and Asia by sea. They helped build Portugal's trading empire and reshaped global commerce.

events.title: Treaty of Ghent signed
events.description: American and British diplomats signed the Treaty of Ghent in Belgium. The treaty ended the War of 1812 and restored prewar boundaries.
events.significance: News travelled slowly, so the Battle of New Orleans was fought after the signing. The treaty opened a long period of peaceful relations between the United States and Britain.

events.title: Libya declares independence
events.description: Libya became an independent kingdom, with Idris I proclaimed its king. It was the first country created through the United Nations.
events.significance: Libya's independence came early in the wave of decolonization across Africa and the Middle East.

events.title: Apollo 8 enters lunar orbit
events.description: Frank Borman, Jim Lovell and William Anders became the first humans to orbit the Moon. On Christmas Eve they broadcast live TV pictures and read from the Book of Genesis.
events.significance: The mission showed that crewed lunar flight was possible, which paved the way for the Moon landing. Its views of Earth from lunar orbit changed how people saw their home planet.
